question: Which candidate entity, if any, can each attributed effective Schedule E fact identify from its reported candidate reference and the same-release candidate master?

inputs.role: The exact attributed effective Schedule E membership and signed amount to resolve without loss.
inputs.version_policy: Pin the exact calculation-set manifest and its immutable Schedule E fact-set ancestry.

inputs.role: Every candidate-master assertion from the same cycle and coordinated FEC source release.
inputs.version_policy: Pin the exact candidate-master fact-set manifest. Historical aliases require a separately versioned input.

identity.result_key: effective Schedule E fact ID + exact input identities + calculation version
identity.input_manifest: Exact effective calculation, Schedule E fact set, and same-release candidate-master fact set, including immutable manifest digests.
identity.method_version: fec/independent-expenditure-candidate-resolution@1.0.0 plus candidate-resolution-method.v2 and the named publisher version
identity.result_digest: SHA-256 over canonical calculation identity fields and deterministic per-fact decision evidence.

ordered_steps: Verify the immutable effective calculation, its Schedule E fact ancestry, and the same-cycle candidate-master fact set. Require one coordinated source release.
Replay the effective membership predicate and select exactly the attributed facts, preserving every signed amount and source-fact ID.
Normalize candidate names as an uppercase Unicode alphanumeric token multiset. Build an office context requiring P; S plus state; or H plus state and normalized district.
Confirm a reported ID only when that ID has the exact context in candidate master. Otherwise resolve only when exactly one candidate ID has that exact context.

When a reported ID exists in candidate master but context cannot corroborate it, retain that ID in an explicit unverified state. Publish ambiguous and absent-ID no-match cases without a resolved candidate ID.
Conserve decision counts and signed minor units exactly across all five states.

decision_states.meaning: The reported candidate ID has an exact candidate-master name and office context assertion.
Exactly one different candidate ID has the exact reported name and office context.
The reported candidate ID exists in candidate master and is retained, but reported context cannot corroborate it.
More than one candidate ID has the exact reported name and office context.
The reported context is insufficient, or the reported ID is absent and no exact context candidate exists.

invariants: Every attributed effective Schedule E fact receives exactly one decision and retains its exact signed amount.
The reported candidate ID is immutable evidence. Resolution adds a nullable resolved ID; it never rewrites the source fact.
Confirmed, resolved, and unverified states carry a resolved candidate ID. Only one unique exact context may replace the reported ID.
No fuzzy, nickname, semantic, LLM, committee-name, pas2, or cross-cycle matching participates in v1.
Candidate election year remains evidence and does not choose candidate identity.
Support and opposition remain separate and are independent expenditures, not candidate-controlled receipts or personal payments.

output.grain: One dense candidate-reference decision per attributed effective Schedule E fact.

publication_states.meaning: All input facts were classified once and signed amounts conserve exactly.
Input identity, backing bytes, replayed membership, decision membership, or signed conservation failed verification.

revisions.input_change_policy: A changed effective calculation or candidate-master fact-set identity creates a new immutable calculation for only that cycle.
revisions.method_change_policy: Any change to normalization, office context, decision order, historical input, or resolution evidence requires a new calculation version.
revisions.history_policy: Retain all source facts, per-fact decisions, exact input identities, and superseded calculation manifests indefinitely.

checks.rule: All exact input manifests and backing artifacts pass digest and membership verification.
Effective, Schedule E, and candidate-master inputs share one cycle and coordinated source release.
Replaying the accepted effective predicate reproduces every attributed fact exactly once.
Every attributed effective fact is exactly one of confirmed, resolved, unverified, ambiguous, or unresolved.
Signed effective cents equal the sum of signed cents in all five states.
Only one unique exact context may replace a reported ID; a present uncorroborated ID remains explicit as unverified.
Every non-projectable decision retains its amount and source-fact identity.

scenarios: reported ID confirmed by exact context
missing reported ID repaired by one exact context
present reported ID with uncorroborated context remains projectable but unverified
no exact candidate and insufficient context remain unresolved
signed amount conservation across every decision state

propagation.no_change_policy: Identical input identities and method version reuse the immutable decision artifact. A changed cycle input recomputes only that cycle and downstream graph projections whose resolved membership changes.

use.retention: Retain every decision outside the graph; project confirmed, resolved, and unverified identities with their quality state while surfacing ambiguous and unresolved amounts as explicit coverage metrics.
use.disclaimer: Resolution identifies an FEC candidate entity for reported independent spending. It does not prove coordination, influence, corruption, a donation, or a personal payment to the candidate.
